module: Provider node "Random Config Provider" (category `once_instant`). Randomly chooses a model and a configuration among the cars (`Type == 'Car'`) with a config having `Top Speed > 10`. Outputs: `model`, `config`, `name` (hidden), `color` (hidden, random paint name of the model or nil).
notes: The options are computed once at first start (`self.options`) from `core_vehicles.getVehicleList()`.
The description of the `color` pin is copied from `name` ("model name").

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Builds the `options` list of eligible models/configs if it does not exist.

drawMiddle.desc: ImGui display in the center of the node in the flowgraph editor; purely visual.

workOnce.desc: Draws a random model, config and paint and writes them to the outputs.
